The answers and the chart digests below were computed by the Lean 4 engine when this file was written; the page recomputes them in your browser and compares.

Every number here is computed from data carried inside this file. Reading a data block back returns exactly the ontology that was published (Wikidata.OnePage.parseJsonl?_blockPayload_dataBlock); the corpus as a whole round-trips (Wikidata.OnePage.parseDocs?_sanitize_docs); the payload cannot escape its element (Wikidata.OnePage.scriptSafeB_sanitize) and the precaution changes nothing (Wikidata.OnePage.sanitize_eq_self); the diagnostics table reads back as written (Wikidata.Report.parseCsvText_csvText); the charts draw one bar per entry and their bars add up (Wikidata.OnePage.corpusBars_count_sum, Wikidata.Report.svgBarLines_length); and a one-variable query answers with exactly the items that satisfy it (Wikidata.OnePage.mem_probe_iff, Wikidata.Query.mem_eval_iff).

The query engine and the chart renderer running in your browser are JavaScript, and are checked rather than proved: the page ships answers and chart digests computed by the verified engine and compares them with its own.
